notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Build complete for portable electronics organizer:

- **Base:** Central full hex (0,0,0) + half bases providing compact portable footprint
- **Removable bins:** 3x small-parts bins with dividers - full-div2 on main base, half-s-full-div3 (3-compartment), half-w-full-div2 (2-compartment)
- **Drawer:** At least one drawer on cut face (0,1,0;n) - classic style
- **Carry handle:** Central handle on top cover

Mesh verification clear, ready for use.
